description: System Advisor Model (SAM) (System Advisor Model) is an open energy model listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Open Models", published or maintained by National Renewable Energy Laboratory. The System Advisor Model (SAM) is a free techno-economic software model that facilitates decision-making for people in the renewable energy industry. Coverage: user-defined regions (as stated on the fact sheet). The fact sheet classes it as: International renewble energy project modeling. Sectors: power generation. Resolution: time Minute. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is BSD-3-Clause (as given on the fact sheet). Caveats: this record was written from the openmod wiki fact sheet, which was read; the source code and documentation were not opened, and the sheet may be out of date (it carries no update date). It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
